# Family Fun Fest

![Family Fun Fest](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/08/FFFseplogo.png)

## THANKS FOR JOINING US AT FAMILY FUN FEST!

From astronauts to crafts, to the ultimate Pinewood Derby at the Texas Motor
Speedway, Family Fun Fest was all about showcasing some of the awesome things
Cub Scouts do. Watch the entire event from start to finish, or check out some
of the fun activities below!

#### AUGUST 8 EVENT

#### SEPTEMBER 12 EVENT

## PINEWOOD DERBY 500 winners

The winners of the national Pinewood Derby 500 at Family Fun Fest have taken
their place among the greats on NASCAR Hall of Fame’s website! Check out the
fastest, fiercest and flashiest cars at
[NASCARHall.com/PinewoodDerby500](http://nascarhall.com/PinewoodDerby500).

## HANDS-ON ACTIVITIES​

Make your own constellation!

Make this awesome constellation projector with items you have at home.

____ Supplies

  * Styrofoam cup
  * A permanent marker
  * A picture of a constellation you
  * want to create
  * A ballpoint pen
  * A flashlight
  * A room you can get dark

Learn the Palomar knot to catch ALL the fish!

Professional Angler Tom Redington shows how to whip out the Palomar knot and
start catching prize-winning bass!

____ Supplies

  * Fishing line
  * A hook or lure (handle these with parent supervision)

Create homemade mucus!

It sounds gross but you can learn a lot about germs from this home project.

____ Supplies

  * Two tablespoons of borax
  * Two plastic containers, labeled “1” and “2”
  * Two cups of warm water in container “1”
  * Three teaspoons of warm water in container “2”
  * Quart-size zippered storage bag
  * Two teaspoons white school glue
  * Pinch of dirt, flour, glitter, or cocoa
  * Food coloring
  * Paper plate
  * Protective gloves

Build a birdhouse with a milk carton!

Grab these supplies from around your house to make a home for the feathered
friends who hang around your yard.

____ Supplies

  * Half-gallon carton
  * Masking tape
  * Paint
  * Glue
  * Scissors
  * String or wire
  * An adult-approved area where you can paint
  * Access to an adult to help with tools you haven’t used before

Make a DIY lava lamp!

This activity is part craft and part science experiment.

____ Supplies

  * Vegetable oil
  * Water
  * Small funnel (optional)
  * Food coloring of your choice
  * Container, like a water bottle or mason jar, to use as your “lamp”
  * A seltzer tablet
  * An adult-approved place to work – like a kitchen a counter

Make Your Own Dog Treats

MasterChef Junior winner Logan Guleff shows us how to make a special treat for
your dog.

____ Supplies

  * Access to a kitchen and an adult to help you with an oven
  * 1 cup of whole wheat flour
  * 1/2 cup of unsweetened pumpkin
  * 1/2 cup unsweetened crunchy peanut butter
  * Baking grease
  * Mixing bowl
  * Spatula
  * Cookie cutters
  * Countertop
  * Rolling pin
  * Basting brush
  *  _Optional:_ carrots and bacon bits

Find more fun, hands-on activities likes these on
[boyslife.org](https://boyslife.org/)!

## JOIN CUB SCOUTS

If you loved Family Fun Fest and all the fun activities featured here, then
you’ll love Cub Scouts!

Cub Scouting is a year-round program uniquely designed to meet the needs of
young boys and girls (kindergarten through fifth grade) and their families.
The program offers fun and challenging activities that promote character
development and physical fitness.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CUB SCOUTS ](https://www.scouting.org/cubscouts/)
